caseStudy.heading: Dispatch Modernization at Scale
caseStudy.description: A representative scenario showing how we would replace manual routing with an autonomous, event-driven agent — not an actual client engagement.
caseStudy.challengeDescription: Manual, human-routed dispatch decisions caused 14% operational latency across the fleet, with no visibility into real-time load conditions.
caseStudy.solutionDescription: Built on Go + a PostgreSQL DAG engine — an autonomous agent that ingests live load and route data, resolves conflicts, and dispatches in real time.
caseStudy.impactDescription: $1.8M in annual savings, with dispatch decisions now resolved in milliseconds instead of manual review cycles.

about.heading: A small, senior development practice.
about.paragraph1: NauticCode is an independent software development practice focused on B2B systems: custom platforms, AI agents, and the infrastructure that keeps them running. No account managers, no bloated teams — you work directly with the people building your system.
about.paragraph2: Have a project in mind, a partnership idea, or just a question? Reach out directly, we read every message ourselves.
